payload.what_was_observed: This repo project-design@0.3.0 has no assessment field (fixtures do; resolver does not require it) and copies the fixture session roster (five continuity types + four investigation types, empty gaps). DESIGN.md still describes a proposed foundation and v0.2 format while the live format is project-design@0.3.0 / catalog 0.6.0. The three-part model (resources, records, views) is only records+views+bundles in the executable contract. ParcelPipe duplicates the same nine types plus work-item/acceptance/check-run. investigation-summary roles use empty all:[] so every observation and finding is selected. Session-loaded size budgets are stated in DESIGN.md and not present in resolve.py or the runtime. DOGFOOD.md still refers to .continuity/ and .records/.
